boundaries.why: a script-writing sandbox agent also pays O(1) control tokens, independent of data size. Token count alone does not distinguish LMPU.
a single model call answers without any pipeline; 93 tokens of protocol buys nothing.
per-token cost is a tokenizer-trie walk sized by the allowed-character set of the FSM state; free-string values walk nearly the whole vocabulary.

honest_framing: Lead with capability (queries whose in-context cost exceeds the window), per-job accounting, bounded-latency decisions inside the compute, and the GPU data plane. Do not lead with token counts against a script.
